slug: 2023-10-30 A political economy analysis of strengthening health information system in Tanzania

facts.fact: The authors (BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making, citing the health sector plan and MUHAS) state that DHIS2, which they describe as web-based software for collecting, validating and analysing data, was piloted and then rolled out to all district councils in Tanzania in 2013; they give no count of councils and do not say how the council offices are connected.
facts.system: DHIS2 rollout to all district councils

systems.tiers: All district councils since 2013; carries more than 90% of data flows from facilities to higher levels

systems.country_label: Facility Financing Accounting and Reporting System
Government of Tanzania Hospital Operations Management Information System
systems.tiers: District hospitals, health centres and dispensaries; introduced 2019
Government financial management; tiers not stated

note: The one fact rests on a web-based national system rolled out to all district councils; the paper names no council office connection. Its statements on poor connectivity concern health facilities in remote areas (interviews April-May 2022), and it says the government has deployed ICT personnel and office space in the councils (capacity), neither of which is a fact for this sub-indicator.
